models.name: primary_exact_recovery_glmer
models.formula: exact_recovery ~ model_id * protocol_variant + model_id * prompt_category + protocol_variant * prompt_category + payload_class + (1 | payload_name) + (1 | prompt_id)

models.name: primary_effective_artifact_rate_lmer
models.formula: effective_artifact_bits_per_full_token ~ model_id * protocol_variant + model_id * prompt_category + protocol_variant * prompt_category + payload_class + (1 | payload_name) + (1 | prompt_id)

models.name: primary_cover_log_probability_lmer
models.formula: mean_log_probability ~ model_id * protocol_variant + model_id * prompt_category + protocol_variant * prompt_category + payload_class + (1 | payload_name) + (1 | prompt_id)
models.input_contract: preprocessed trial table has one saved-token replay row per payload condition; raw segments are not passed to the mixed model
